tier_questions.text: Does the agent communicate directly with external parties (customers, regulators, suppliers)?
Does the agent take autonomous write-actions on systems of record (CRM, ERP, payment, marketing platforms)?
Does the agent operate within a regulated function (pricing, credit eligibility, safety decisions)?
Is the user base internal, trusted and bounded, with outputs advisory rather than authoritative?
Is the deployment explicitly time-boxed (<90 days), with <100 users and no autonomous write-actions?

tiers.name: Low risk, productivity-centric
tiers.definition: Individual / immediate team productivity with low authority, bounded assist/read use cases, reversible outcomes; no write to enterprise source systems; non-sensitive (internal) data; pre-approved tools; no MC data.
tiers.examples: Internal drafting, summarization, search, coding assistance with no sensitive data or actions.

tiers.name: Medium risk, advisory, limited action
tiers.definition: Team or department level agents; bounded read/assist, reversible outcomes; non-sensitive data; internal-only approved tools and connectors; no MC data; no write-backs to BC or SOX enterprise systems; limited autonomy within predefined steps.
tiers.examples: RAG over business knowledge, internal workflow recommendations, controlled tool use.

tiers.name: High risk, sensitive, material operational authority/impact
tiers.definition: Enterprise-shared agents supporting operational processes; controlled write access to BC systems (excluding SOX); broader reach (externally facing); workflow execution with human-in-the-loop guardrails; personal sensitive (GDPR) data but no MC.
tiers.examples: Sensitive data, privileged actions, customer/employee impact, automated decision support.

tiers.name: Very high risk
tiers.definition: Potential harm to people (e.g. safety systems) or irreversible actions; high autonomy; MC data; external users or safety/financial (e.g. SOX) critical systems; human oversight of every output required.
tiers.examples: Autonomous write actions on systems of record, regulated decisions.

tier_dimensions: Blast radius – how many users, transactions or decisions one agent error affects
Reversibility – can an error be undone? Irreversible actions need a human write-gate
Regulatory exposure – regulated domain (pricing, credit, consent, energy retail, data residency)?
